sample_size_recommendation: none; exceedance of the cap on a fresh sample is not a calibrated 5% test of a pre-fixed contrast, so this simulation is not converted into a network count
reading: The pointwise 95% upper bound, followed by a max over the grid, exceeds the 5% cap on the fresh test groups more often than the simultaneous Bonferroni bound. Neither rate is a distribution-free guarantee for a new river archive.
